continuityChecksRetained.fact: Shared lake energy changes Seth, Jenny, Perch and Laura; Fist comes from Daniel’s separate reanimation experiment. Billy and Fist do not hear Flaming Head.
Flaming Head’s words are private throughout Book Three; unmoving mouth is explicit at Laura’s introduction. Seth/Jenny relay to Billy and Fist. Laura’s connection fades after her cure.
Seth and Jenny received costumes through Flaming Head’s power; masks do not fool people who already know them. Laura receives hers the same way.
Fist ends Book Two with a torn cuff and heals gradually before the bank action. Seth’s controlled lift pays off Book Two’s failed drum exercise.
Claude’s gift does not clear Eleanor’s unresolved involvement or make him knowingly complicit. Masked hero photographs do not identify Jenny’s civilian role to the general public.
Expelled plasma powers the test; the tray catches residue. Laura loses her power only through direct collector contact in the rescue.
Dork retreats after Laura burns his coat; Luke tries to stop her and braces the housing. The collector explosion hurls him through the western window. He does not choose a heroic power cut.

Laura’s remorse, Flaming Head’s pride and vow, harmless sneezes and departure precede Luke awakening. The ending stays with Daniel pleased by the newly loyal Jaws. Sun sacrifice and tank battle remain for Book Four.
